title: Paloma Rewards Earning Rate Card
content:
Points on a completed personal transfer under Paloma Rewards are built from three tier figures: base points for the transfer, additional points for each full 100 USD of principal, and a multiplier for the delivery method, with a per-transfer maximum after the multiplier.

## Rates by tier

| Tier | Base points per completed transfer | Additional points per full 100 USD of principal | Bank Deposit multiplier | Cash Pickup multiplier | Mobile Wallet multiplier | Most points one transfer can earn after multipliers |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Rewards Blue | 10 | 1 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 60 |
| Paloma Rewards Silver | 12 | 1 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.25 | 80 |
| Paloma Rewards Gold | 15 | 2 | 1.25 | 1.00 | 1.25 | 120 |
| Paloma Rewards Platinum | 18 | 2 | 1.25 | 1.25 | 1.50 | 160 |
| Paloma Rewards Diamond | 22 | 3 | 1.50 | 1.25 | 1.50 | 220 |
| Paloma Rewards Elite | 25 | 3 | 1.50 | 1.50 | 1.50 | 300 |

## Which multiplier applies

The multiplier follows the delivery method of the transfer:

| Delivery method | Multiplier column used |
|---|---|
| Bank Deposit | Bank Deposit multiplier |
| Cash Pickup | Cash Pickup multiplier |
| Mobile Wallet | Mobile Wallet multiplier |

A multiplier of 1.00 leaves the points unchanged; 1.25 and 1.50 raise them by a quarter and by a half respectively.

## Notes on the card

- Only full 100 USD steps of principal earn the additional points: a principal of 299.99 USD contains two full steps, a principal of 300.00 USD contains three.
- The maximum in the last column is applied after the multiplier, so no single transfer earns more than that figure on the tier.
- Mobile Wallet is raised above 1.00 from Paloma Rewards Silver upward; Bank Deposit from Paloma Rewards Gold upward; Cash Pickup from Paloma Rewards Platinum upward.
